lines: Yemeni civil war 2026 Yemen offensives The Houthis launches missiles against the airports of Najran and Jizan, in Saudi Arabia, causing material damages and wounding three people. (Al Jazeera)

Gaza war Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz says that the Israel Defense Forces has killed 4,000 militants who took part in the Hamas-led attacks on Israel on October 7, 2023. (The Jewish Chronicle)
A ship sinks off the coast of Bulgaria after being struck by a drone. (Reuters)
Acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery by Paramount The merger between Paramount Skydance and Warner Bros. Discovery into Skydance takes effect. (CNN)
2026 Ebola epidemic Kenya confirms its first imported case of the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebolavirus in Nairobi in a deceased male who traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. (Reuters)
Nairobi Hospital steps up its infection-control measures, tracing, and staff monitoring following Kenya's first imported case of Ebola. (The Star Kenya)
The Daily Mail reports that a second person has died from a pneumonic plague outbreak that contains Yersinia pestis. (Insider Paper)

2024 Cornell University rape allegations The faculty of Cornell University are reportedly preparing a no-confidence vote against the university's administration, including its president, Michael Kotlikoff, over its handling of rape allegations from 2024. (CNN)

August Hanning, former head of Germany's Federal Intelligence Service, is arrested at his home in Nordwalde after being charged by the country's Federal Public Prosecutor General with treason, espionage, and trading state secrets. A former aide of Hanning's is also arrested for aiding and abetting attempted treason and treasonous espionage. (Deutsche Welle) (AP)
Riots break out in Liège, Belgium, following a day of student protests, resulting in damaged shops and destroyed bus shelters in the city center. (Le Soir)

2026 Kosovan presidential election After passing the jurisdiction amendments to the Kosovo Specialist Chambers, the Kuvendi began the procedure to elect a president on 6 October, finishing the voting process minutes after the constitutional deadline on midnight 7 October. Justina Pula is declared the next president of Kosovo. (Kosovo Online) (Prishtina Insight)

Belgian physicist Francis Halzen from the University of Wisconsin–Madison is awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics for his "decisive contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and the discovery of high-energy neutrinos of astrophysical origin". (CNN)
